item: Outer panels: EPP foam 1.9 lb/ft3 cores (hot-wired, elevons cut free)
Outer panels: laminating film, hinge and leading-edge tape
Elevon stiffeners: 3 x 1 mm carbon strip
Spar: telescoping carbon tubes 12x10 pultruded > 10x8 pultruded > 8x6 pultruded mm, both panels
Spar carry-through: 2 roll-wrapped sleeves + 2 carbon strip caps (10x1 mm)
Anti-rotation pins: 3 mm carbon rod at 60 % chord
Tip fins: EPP, laminated, pegged and taped on (replaceable)
Belly skid: EPP block + HDPE wear strip, velcro (replaceable)
Airspeed: Matek ASPD-4525 + pitot tube, silicone line
Camera Module 3 (standard lens) + 15 cm Zero ribbon
Flight controller: SpeedyBee F405 WING or Matek F405-WTE (ArduPilot; PDB, current sensor, BECs)
5 V 3 A buck BEC for the Pi (keeps camera noise off the FC rail)
ELRS 2.4 GHz receiver with telemetry: RadioMaster RP2
Remote ID broadcast module (must be on the FAA DoC list)
Prop: folding 10x6 (nylon blades, 40 mm yoke, spinner)
Wiring: XT60 + 14 AWG power, motor leads, servo extensions with panel plugs, signal leads
Hardware: hatch magnets, nylon panel bolts, velcro straps, glue
Elevon servo: Emax ES08MD II, 12 g digital metal-gear (each) x2
Servo horn, pushrod, clevis (each side) x2
assembled aircraft, ready to fly (overrides the sum)
